question: The rooftop of Guru Hemkund Sahib is in the shape of an upturned ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**lotus.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The rooftop of Guru Hemkund Sahib is in the shape of an upturned lotus.**

 
• Hemkund Sahib, formally known as **Gurudwara Shri Hemkund Sahib Ji.**
 
• It is a Sikh place of worship and pilgrimage site in Chamoli district, Uttarakhand, India.
 
• It is devoted to Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru.

 [IMAGE: https://www.hemkunt.in/beautiful-pictures/india/uttarakhand/chamoli-district/latest-hd-images-pictures-of-hemkund-sahib/hemkunt-sahib/hemkund-sahib.jpg]
